title: This Turns Your Entire Codebase Into One AI Prompt 🤯💻
description:
I discovered Code2Prompt, a useful tool for giving AI coding assistants more context from your project 🤖💻

Instead of manually copying files one by one, Code2Prompt can collect your project's relevant source code, organize the structure, and turn it into a single AI-friendly prompt.

This can be especially useful when you're working with an unfamiliar codebase or want an AI model to understand multiple files at once.

If you're using AI for coding, this is a seriously useful little tool to bookmark.
